posts.content_md: I've been toying with the idea of making a HOE mirror for my cave holography camera. Have any of you had good luck making one? I'll probably use Ultimate 08.

posts.author: Ed Wesly
posts.content_md:
What do you have in mind for the mirror to do? Beamsplitting, focussing, diffusing?

I have made a variety of HOE's for various applications, unfortunately my web site is down that has the paper I wrote with TJ on HOE's for Holography.

posts.author: John Klayer
posts.content_md:
> **Ed Wesly:** What do you have in mind for the mirror to do? Beamsplitting, focussing, diffusing?

Yeah, all of the above in one HOE would be great. 

What I want to do is make my cave holography contraption smaller by hopefully using a reflection HOE. Here is what I presently have:

![Image](http://i39.tinypic.com/2eeewzc.jpg)

I'm wondering if I could get rid of the convex mirror on top of the aluminum L by replacing it with a HOE to mimic its diverging beam nearer to the plate holder (the black thing on the bottom). What ever light leaks thru the HOE would be used for additional object illumination. Maybe also eliminate the diffuser (metallic thing above the plate holder) and the beam splitter to boot.
